title: Christchurch to Wanaka
notes: Inland via Lake Tekapo and Lake Pukaki, over the Lindis Pass. Coffee and photo stop at Pukaki.

title: Lake Dunstan Trail then Queenstown
notes: Cromwell to Clyde, 42km hugging the lake on boardwalks clipped to the cliff face. Shuttle back to the car at Cromwell, then 45min on to Queenstown.

title: Queenstown wine and family
notes: Gibbston Valley and Bannockburn cellar doors. Dinner with Luke's sister.

title: Queenstown free day
notes: Skyline gondola, TSS Earnslaw across the lake, or the adventure-sport menu for whoever wants it.

title: Queenstown to Te Anau
notes: Short driving day. Lakefront evening, early night before the cruise.

title: Doubtful Sound day cruise
notes: From Manapouri, 20min away: boat across Lake Manapouri, bus over Wilmot Pass, then the cruise. Book ahead.

title: Te Anau to Franz Josef
notes: Big one, but the best driving in the country. Lunch in Wanaka at the halfway mark, then Blue Pools and Thunder Creek Falls over Haast Pass.

title: Franz Josef to Nelson
notes: 3hrs up the coast through Hokitika, long lunch and walks at Punakaiki, 3hrs more through Westport and the Buller. Check the tide chart the night before.

title: Great Taste Trail e-bike
notes: Nelson to Mapua, 35km, grade 1 and almost entirely off-road via Rabbit Island. Finish with the Mapua ferry and lunch on the wharf.

title: Nelson to Marlborough via Kaiteriteri
notes: An hour over the hill to Kaiteriteri for lunch on the golden sand, then across to wine country.

title: Marlborough to Christchurch
notes: A cellar door or two on the way out, then down the coast: crayfish at Nin's Bin, seals at Point Kean, and the last run home.
